protocol.chrome: headed, --disable-features=CalculateNativeWinOcclusion (WebGPU needs D3D12; headless has no adapter here)
protocol.step: qa.step(N, 0.016666666666666666) then 2 rounds of qa.stepFrame(0) + 2 rAF

gates.g1: any heading 8-14 bg patches, not merging into slabs (sweep frames, counted visually)
gates.g2: through-cloud triple: white surround / plane visible / thickness (probe frames)
gates.g3: ?tod=12 hard edge gone, incl. ?tod=12&bg=0 isolation frame (design §6)
gates.g4: veil entry shows no hard cutoff layer; else VEIL_INNER 0.96->0.93 fallback
gates.g5: alt low + alt=240 still show several patches
gates.g6: anti-goal: far view not empty-clean (sky must not look fake)
